limits: Retrieval, not judgement: rows are sorted by EDHREC rank (unranked last) with every signal stated per row; nothing here scores fit. A row flagged `infinite_with` sorts after every unflagged row in its dimension and is never dropped.

Oracle predicates are regexes over printed text and read what the text says, not what the card does at a table: a drain keyed to a trigger the deck never fires is still a drain here. `matched` names the predicate ids so a reader can re-run the question.
Keywords and power are PRINTED (`card_pool.card_keywords`); a granted keyword or a pumped body does not count, and a `*` power reads as unknown, not 0.

`infinite_with` is read from combo_details two-card lines whose other card is in the 99 (or the staged list under --against-branch); a three-card line is counted in `two_card_lines`/`bracket_max` only. Game Changers are dropped (bracket 3) and counted.
`edhrec` per row is present only when edhrec_cards.json exists for the deck, dated by its own as_of; absent means not fetched, never zero.
